summary.name: Rocket.Chat
summary.one_liner: Rocket.Chat is a self-hostable team messaging platform with voice, video, apps and AI, aimed at secure and sovereign deployments.
use_cases: secure team messaging inside an organization
EU-hosted compliant collaboration with member states
situational awareness with TAK and ATAK
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Rocket.Chat as a messaging platform that includes voice, video, apps and AI, designed to connect users with partners on any system. Deployment options named are inside the customer's own environment, an EU-hosted sovereign cloud, or fully air-gapped. Security features listed include post-quantum encrypted conversations, attribute-based access and identity controls, granular data retention policies, and comprehensive audit logs that extend across federated partners. It states integration with TAK and ATAK for situational awareness. Customer quotes mention secure messaging, audio and video calls, document sharing, and access segmentation by classified program.
notable: Deployable self-hosted, air-gapped, or in an EU-hosted sovereign cloud
Post-quantum encrypted conversations and zero trust positioning
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing and customer testimonials with few technical specifics
